title: @ reference_image Create a 15 second photorealistic live sports broadcast video…
content:
@ reference_image Create a 15 second photorealistic live sports broadcast video using the exact 80 year old Japanese lady from the uploaded reference image. Preserve her face, hairstyle, skin tone, wrinkles, body shape, age, expression, and identity. Do not make her younger or turn her into another person.

Official BMX TV SPORTS live broadcast during a packed Argentina vs Brazil football match in a modern stadium at golden hour daylight. High angle professional broadcast camera from the main gantry, long optical zoom lens, smooth tripod pan and tilt, no handheld shake, natural 4K live TV texture, slight broadcast compression.

Static top-left scoreboard: “BMX TV SPORTS | 67:42 | ARG 2 – 1 BRA | LIVE HD”. Static top-right white and blue “BMX TV” logo. All graphics remain fixed.

0–4s: Camera cuts to the front-row crowd. Fans in Argentina and Brazil jerseys cheer naturally. The camera finds the elderly Japanese lady from @  reference_image wearing an elegant dark brown kimono inspired silk dress, comfortable low heels, and minimal gold jewelry. She is eating a burger and holding a blue soda can. She notices herself on the giant stadium screen, pauses, then gives a wise confident smirk.

Voiceover 0–4s: “Wait a second… the crowd cam just found someone unforgettable!”

4–8s: Stewards open a small pitch-side access gate for a planned BMX TV halftime fan challenge. She places the burger and soda on her seat, stands slowly but confidently, and walks onto the grass with graceful elderly poise. Camera pans and zooms out smoothly.

Voiceover 4–8s: “She’s stepping onto the pitch for the BMX TV halftime challenge!”

8–12s: An Argentina player in a white warm-up bib gently rolls the ball to her feet while a Brazil player smiles nearby. Despite her age, she traps the ball calmly, takes one small step back, and strikes it cleanly with the front of her low heel. A sharp “thwack” is heard.

Voiceover 8–12s: “Look at that touch… and she takes the shot!”

12–15s: The ball flies in a fast believable arc into the top corner of the goal. The goalkeeper dives late and misses. The net snaps back. The stadium erupts with laughter, applause, and a huge roar. She turns to the lens, smiles warmly, laughs, and gently covers the camera with her hand.

Voiceover 12–15s: “Unbelievable! Top corner! A legendary moment on BMX TV!”

Audio: live commentator voiceover, stadium crowd hum, flag rustle, announcer echo, heel-ball impact, net snap, applause, laughter, huge crowd roar. No music, no slow motion, no drone shot. True live sports broadcast style, photorealistic 4K, 60fps, natural daylight, realistic optical zoom, believable ball physics.

Negative prompt: younger woman, changed age, different person, face swap, smooth young skin, distorted face, extra fingers, warped body, fake crowd, empty stadium, pitch invasion, security breach, moving scoreboard, floating TV logo, distorted text, impossible ball physics, handheld shake, glossy fashion commercial look, cartoon physics, brand logos except BMX TV.
